svg.title: social-notifier messages in Telegram
svg.desc: Left, the posts chat: one message lists new posts from VK, Instagram, a blog, YouTube and a Telegram channel, each a link. Right, the alerts chat: an alert that Instagram posts can't be read for 20 minutes with what to do and the reason, then a notice that posts are being read again.
svg.text: POSTS CHAT
Newsroom bot
New posts — give them a like and a share:
VK: Home is the people around you
Instagram: Five children are no reason to give up
Blog: Who keeps the archive of a city
YouTube: Episode 12: why we still read letters
Telegram: What we read this week
ALERTS CHAT
Newsroom bot
Instagram: can't read posts for 20 min.
What to do: issue a new token and update the
META_TOKEN secret in the repository settings
(Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions).
Posts published in the meantime will arrive after
the fix if they are among the latest 25 and no
older than 48 h.
Reason: auth — Graph API 190/463: Error
validating access token: Session has expired
Newsroom bot
Instagram: posts are being read again.
